name: apple-reminders
description: Turn meeting notes, screenshots, and plans into organized Apple Reminders from Codex on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Turn notes and screenshots into Apple Reminders
interface.longDescription: Use Codex to turn meeting notes and screenshots into reminders, create items in exact lists, review upcoming work, organize sections, update attachments, and recover an exact item from Recently Deleted. The plugin runs locally on macOS and verifies writes with read-backs. Changes may sync through Apple accounts and shared lists; there is no plugin-owned remote backend.
defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into action items and deadlines, then add them to my Work list
Create one Apple Reminder per screenshot in my Applications list, preserving any dates and links
Brief me on everything overdue, due today, and coming up this week
